acceptance.criterion: Post with `ship` and `invoice` (with `expectedCount` 1) of an order with an Item line and a Resource line, full quantities: one `Service Shipment` and one `Service Invoice` in `postedDocuments`, item, resource, service and customer ledger entries exist, `orderDeleted` true when BC removed the order; response counts equal the entries
Post `ship` only, then `invoice` only: first call gives a shipment and `quantityShipped` on the lines; second gives an invoice for the shipped quantity
Post `ship` and `consume` with `Qty. to Consume` on the lines: consumption is posted (service ledger entries of type Consume, `quantityConsumed`), no invoice
Partial quantities: `Qty. to Ship` 1 of 3: the order stays, `quantityShipped` = 1; a second Post continues from the remaining quantity
No flag sent: Ship and Invoice is posted (default). `consume` with `invoice`, or `consume` without `ship`: `InvalidParameter`, nothing posted
Nothing to post (all `Qty. to ...` 0): BC's "nothing to post" text as `PreconditionFailed` with the nextStep naming the line fields; nothing posted
User Setup service invoice posting policy Prohibited and `invoice = true`: `PreconditionFailed` naming the policy; policy Mandatory and `ship` without `invoice`: `PreconditionFailed`; nothing posted

BC refusals (missing posting setup, posting date outside the allowed period, blocked customer) are returned as `BusinessCentralError` with BC's text; no entries, no posted document, the order unchanged (atomic)

Post without `expectedCount` answers `ConfirmationRequired` (`expected` = 1, summary names the order and the options), nothing posted; wrong count `ConfirmationMismatch`; with the company setting off omission posts; a supplied wrong count still refuses
Without `BIFROST SvcPost ori`: Post and PreviewPost are not listed and a direct Post answers `PermissionDenied` naming the set; with only the token set plus the base permissions Post runs

PreviewPost returns the entries Post would create (`entryCount` equals the entries a following Post creates for the same options), leaves no entry, no posted document and no number-series use; under Omit Commit it answers `PreconditionFailed`

Parameter validation: missing identifier `MissingParameter`; `ship` / `consume` / `invoice` not a boolean (also `null`) `InvalidParameterFormat`; several problems with declared parameters in one call (for example `"ship":"yes"` and `"invoice":3`) answer `MultipleErrors` and post nothing. An undeclared key is refused by Foundation's strict dispatcher with `UnknownParameter` before the app runs; that is Foundation's contract, so test it on its own (`{"no":"<order>","ship":true,"extra":"x"}` answers `UnknownParameter` for `extra`) and do not expect it inside `MultipleErrors`

Commit and Omit Commit: Post behaves like Warehouse's posting types (`Whse Omit Commit Tests`): BC's commit is not suppressed, so the call is documented as committing; the test asserts the documented behaviour and that a failing call leaves nothing posted

Write guard: `Data.Records.Set` on `Service Line` Quantity Shipped, Quantity Invoiced, Quantity Consumed or their Base fields is refused with Foundation's field-restriction answer `PermissionDenied` (as Foundation emits it for every app; `BlockedByWriteGuard` is the separate Change Log guard) and the hint `Service.Order.Post`; `Qty. to Ship`, `Qty. to Invoice`, `Qty. to Consume` stay writable; `Svc Posting ori` is hidden from `Data.Records.Set`

End to end (97746): create a quote with `Data.Records.Set`, `Service.Quote.MakeOrder`, `Service.Allocation.Allocate`, `Service.Order.Release`, set `Qty. to Ship` and `Qty. to Consume`, `Service.Order.PreviewPost`, `Service.Order.Post` ship and consume, then the rest ship and invoice; every step through `Dispatcher ori`

Contracts: both types declare envelope, target, parameters, response, errors, effect (`irreversible` for Post, `read` for PreviewPost), related, workflow, examples (each of the four combinations), overview, notes; Post's effect text says it commits; `expectedCount` appears in the described Post contract; errors include `ConfirmationRequired`, `ConfirmationMismatch`, `PermissionDenied`, `PreconditionFailed`
Licence: an unlicensed company answers `EULA_REQUIRED` and posts nothing
